name: Komatsu Ltd.
summary: Komatsu Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of construction, mining, utility, forestry, and industrial machinery worldwide. It operates in three segments: Construction Machinery and Vehicles, Retail Finance, and Industrial Machinery and Others. The company offers construction and mining equipment, such as hydraulic and mini excavators, bulldozers, wheel loaders, dump trucks, rope and hybrid shovels, continuous miners, and jumbo drills; and demolition, waste, and recycling equipment, including mini shovels, mobile crushers, and hydraulic excavators with a cutter, pulverizer, and magnet.
